gdelt._tuneNote: Calibrated from a live probe 2026-06-07: avg intensity 3.31 (range 2.2-4.7) over 90d -> ~46/100 with lo=1.0/hi=6.0 ('moderate, headroom'). Re-check the printed 'GDELT avg intensity' periodically and adjust hi up (cooler) or down (hotter). GDELT is keyless; attribution + a link required by their terms.

fred.sourceLabel: FRED (St. Louis Fed), incl. World Bank Gini

series.label: 30-year fixed mortgage rate
series._note: Housing cost pressure. The store listing has claimed this factor covers housing affordability since v1.0 while the basket measured only inequality, debt service and real earnings. 3% is the cheap-money floor of the 2010s-21; 9% is above every reading since 1995.

fred._basketNote: Four equally weighted series: inequality, household debt service, real median earnings (inverted) and the 30-year mortgage rate.

voteview._measure: Absolute distance between Democratic and Republican first-dimension median DW-NOMINATE scores in the House. This is the published measure of the thing the app claims polarization is: ideological distance between the major parties.
voteview._normalizeNote: 0 = 0.50, about the least polarized post-war Congress (the 91st sits at 0.4975). 100 = 1.00, complete separation of the party medians on the first dimension. The 119th Congress reads 0.9255, the highest in the post-war series.
